taskBaseInfo.taskDescription: X1 29-DoF allmimic (SuperMimic re-implementation) on the 41-clip CMU walking library: 3000 iterations, 4096 envs, 1x4090D. Entry scripts/gm_x1_train.py pip-installs requirements.txt, verifies CUDA/mjlab, trains with configs/x1_supermimic.json, mirrors runs/x1_cmu_walk/log.jsonl to TensorBoard under logs/x1_supermimic/, and publishes the newest checkpoint to output/.
